⚛ SPICE Model Benchmark

Comprehensive MOSFET device model verification and benchmarking system

Overview Architecture Results GitHub

Overview

The SPICE Model Benchmark system automates the comprehensive verification of semiconductor MOSFET compact models across four physical domains. It runs ngspice and Spectre simulations, analyzes results, and generates detailed pass/fail reports with publication-quality plots.

⚡ DC Analysis

IV characteristics, temperature sweeps (−40°C to 150°C), bias point analysis, KCL verification

⇄ Transient Analysis

Large-signal response, inverter switching, delay chains, power dissipation, quasi-static behavior

≈ AC Analysis

CV characteristics (1kHz–1MHz), S-parameters (1MHz–10GHz), NQS effects, charge conservation

☷ Noise Analysis

Thermal noise (6 bias points), flicker (1/f) noise, shot noise, temperature-dependent noise

Quick Start

# Install
pip install -e .

# Run ngspice benchmark (default)
spice-benchmark models/FreePDK45/nom.inc --modes dc transient

# Run Spectre benchmark
spice-benchmark models/FreePDK45/nom.inc --simulator spectre --modes dc transient

# Compare both simulators
spice-benchmark models/FreePDK45/nom.inc --simulator ngspice spectre --modes dc
